answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, anchoring each identity thread with staking collateral gated by zero-knowledge delay. Capital barrier analysis proves Sybil multiplication requires deposited collateral, which the beacon monitors and catastrophically slashes into shale, generating strictly negative expected utility. Consequently, Nash equilibrium convergence shows identity duplication yields strictly suboptimal returns, formally validating robust Sybil resistance against adversarial environments.
